name: Evidence Collection — Latest Gate Evidence
mechanical_verification: Collect evidence for different gates, verify getLatestEvidence returns correct gate evidence
prompt: Evaluate plan gate as passed, then call shark-evidence action=gate-evidence gate=plan, then evaluate build gate and check evidence
expected_behavior: Evidence shows timestamp, passed status, metadata for each gate

verification_steps.expected: Evidence returned with passed: true, gate: plan
verification_steps.mechanical_pass: Latest evidence for plan gate correct

verification_steps.action: Verify evidence has timestamp and metadata
verification_steps.expected: Evidence includes timestamp, passed, metadata object

pass_criteria.plan_evidence: Plan gate evidence shows passed: true
pass_criteria.build_evidence: Build gate evidence shows passed: true

failure_modes.evidence_missing: No evidence returned for evaluated gate
failure_modes.missing_fields: Evidence missing timestamp or passed status
